description: Search and paginate the tracked queries (keywords) of a project with their latest rank positions and metrics. Filter by status (active/paused), engines, countries and a free-text search. Sort by one of: queryText, lastSerpPosition, lastMentionPosition, lastShoppingPosition, lastShareOfVoice, lastPositivityIndex, lastMentionCount, lastCheckedAt. limit is 1-100 (default 20). Answers questions like "list my top queries by share of voice" or "find a specific tracked query".

countries.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country codes (e.g. "US", "GB", "DE"); a project's configured codes are listed by get_available_filters

engines.description: allowed values: chatgpt, perplexity, google_ai_overview, google_ai_mode, google_serp, google_shopping

name: search_tracked_queries
title: Search tracked queries
